plans.note: Re-read today. Standard lists a 'Free license choice (pick 1)' that includes 'Takeaway & delivery license' (also 'QR ordering system license'); implementation and training '30,750 MKD including VAT' billed separately. No monthly/yearly toggle. The pricing page never uses the words 'online ordering'; its online-ordering page says 'Create your free ordering page today' and 'set your pickup and delivery preferences' but names no plan. Basic (3.699) and 'Basic + Website' (4.990, '*Does not include ecommerce') carry no takeaway licence, so Standard is the cheapest plan that plausibly includes online ordering. Weak: reviewer to confirm.

notes: MK counts Vitrina (MKD). Thinker POS (stored e01cb953, food_truck, Skopje, MKD) was recorded eligible in compare-research-5 with one doubt: which plan carries online ordering. Re-read today (pricing + online-ordering pages): the pricing page still never says 'online ordering'; Standard (6.295 MKD/month incl. VAT) and Advanced (8.693) offer a free-choice 'Takeaway & delivery license', Basic and 'Basic + Website' ('*Does not include ecommerce') do not, and the online-ordering page names no plan ('Create your free ordering page today'). If the reviewer accepts the Takeaway & delivery licence as the online-ordering module, MK reaches 2 (Thinker POS is a food-truck tool). Stopped MK there (no new search).
